title: 计算机科学，从零搭建 · 第57部分：学习理论

chapters.Hook: 学习在什么时候是可能的
chapters.Margins: 3. 间隔与 Rademacher 复杂度

d877f68fc589.en: Here is a puzzle that learning theory had to face. <bookmark mark='a'/> We fit fifty noisy examples with a linear model that uses p features. With few features the model is too simple. As p grows, the error on new data rises, slowly and then steeply, the classical picture of overfitting. <bookmark mark='b'/> At p equal to fifty the model can fit anything, noise included, and the test error explodes. <bookmark mark='c'/> And then, past that point, adding still more parameters makes the error fall again, to below where it started: at 200 features it is lower than any model with fewer parameters than examples. This is double descent. To understand it we first need the classical theory: when is learning possible at all, and how many examples does it take?
d877f68fc589.zh: 这里有一个学习理论不得不面对的谜题。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们用一个使用 p 个特征的线性模型，去拟合50个带噪声的样例。特征很少时，模型太简单。随着 p 增大，在新数据上的误差上升，先是缓慢，然后陡峭：这是过拟合的经典图景。<bookmark mark='b'/>在 p 等于50时，模型能拟合任何东西，连噪声也一起拟合，测试误差随之爆炸。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，越过这一点，再增加更多的参数，误差反而又降了下来，降到比起点还低：在200个特征时，它比任何参数少于样例的模型都低。这就是双下降。要理解它，我们首先需要经典理论：学习究竟在什么时候是可能的，又需要多少样例？

85e4e65993db.en: AI, Built showed machines that learn. This part asks what can be proved about them. <bookmark mark='a'/> How many examples does a learner need before its answers are probably approximately correct? Leslie Valiant made the question precise in 1984, and the answer is a single number, the VC dimension. <bookmark mark='b'/> What if no distribution exists and an adversary picks every example? Then the right measure is regret, and the answers include the bandits of Part 44. <bookmark mark='c'/> And what can never be learned efficiently, however much data there is? There the answers come from cryptography.
85e4e65993db.zh: 《人工智能，从零搭建》展示了会学习的机器。这一部分要问的是，关于它们能证明些什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个学习器需要多少样例，它的答案才是概率近似正确的？Leslie Valiant 在1984年把这个问题表述得精确，而答案是一个数：VC 维。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果根本不存在分布，每个样例都由一个对手来挑选呢？那么正确的度量是遗憾，而答案中包括第44部分的老虎机。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有，无论数据有多少，什么东西永远无法被高效地学会？那里的答案来自密码学。

a8cd427077a1.en: This is Part 57 of Computer Science, Built. <bookmark mark='a'/> We will define probably approximately correct learning; prove that the VC dimension decides how many examples are needed; see why margins, not dimensions, govern the perceptron and boosting; learn online against an adversary and bound the regret; meet problems that cannot be learned efficiently; and return to double descent and to learning as compression.
a8cd427077a1.zh: 这是《计算机科学，从零搭建》的第57部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们会定义概率近似正确学习；证明 VC 维决定了需要多少样例；看看为什么支配感知机和提升法的是间隔，而不是维数；在对手面前在线学习，并给遗憾定界；遇到无法被高效学会的问题；最后回到双下降，以及作为压缩的学习。

c5af6addd47d.en: In 1984 Leslie Valiant asked what it should mean for a machine to learn from examples. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nature fixes a distribution over inputs, which the learner never sees, and a target from a class the learner knows: here, a hidden rectangle. <bookmark mark='b'/> The learner receives m examples, each drawn from the distribution with its label, and returns a hypothesis: here, the tightest box around the positive points. <bookmark mark='c'/> Its error is the probability of the region where hypothesis and target disagree, shaded red. <bookmark mark='d'/> Valiant asked that, with probability at least one minus delta over the sample, the error be at most epsilon, <bookmark mark='e'/> for every distribution and every target, using examples and computation polynomial in one over epsilon and one over delta. Probably, approximately, correct.
c5af6addd47d.zh: 1984年，Leslie Valiant 问：一台机器从样例中学习，应该意味着什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>大自然固定一个输入上的分布，学习器永远看不到它；还固定一个目标，它来自学习器知道的一个类：这里是一个隐藏的矩形。<bookmark mark='b'/>学习器收到 m 个样例，每个都从这个分布中抽取，并带着它的标签；然后返回一个假设：这里是围住正例点的最紧的方框。<bookmark mark='c'/>它的误差，是假设与目标不一致的那片区域的概率，用红色标出。<bookmark mark='d'/>Valiant 要求：在样本的随机性上，以至少1减 delta 的概率，误差至多是 epsilon，<bookmark mark='e'/>而且对每一个分布、每一个目标都成立，所用的样例和计算量都是 epsilon 分之一和 delta 分之一的多项式。概率地、近似地、正确。

67bf4e010ef6.en: Start with a finite class that contains a perfect hypothesis, the realizable case, and call a hypothesis bad if its error exceeds epsilon. <bookmark mark='a'/> A fixed bad hypothesis survives each random example with probability less than one minus epsilon, so it survives all m of them with probability at most e to the minus epsilon m. <bookmark mark='b'/> By the union bound of Part 2, the chance that any bad hypothesis survives is at most the class size times that. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ask for this to be at most delta, <bookmark mark='d'/> and solve: m at least one over epsilon, times the log of the class size plus the log of one over delta. <bookmark mark='e'/> For a thousand hypotheses, with epsilon and delta both five hundredths, a hundred and ninety-nine examples suffice, whichever consistent hypothesis is returned. The class size enters only through its logarithm.
67bf4e010ef6.zh: 从一个包含完美假设的有限类开始，这是可实现的情形；如果一个假设的误差超过 epsilon，就称它是坏的。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个固定的坏假设，在每个随机样例上存活下来的概率小于1减 epsilon，所以它在全部 m 个样例上都存活下来的概率至多是 e 的负 epsilon m 次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>由第2部分的联合界，任何一个坏假设存活下来的概率，至多是类的大小乘以这个数。<bookmark mark='c'/>要求它至多是 delta，<bookmark mark='d'/>然后求解：m 至少是 epsilon 分之一，乘以类大小的对数加上 delta 分之一的对数。<bookmark mark='e'/>对1000个假设，epsilon 和 delta 都取0.05，199个样例就足够了，无论返回的是哪一个一致的假设。类的大小只通过它的对数进入。

a60ee06bb02b.en: Usually no hypothesis is perfect. The agnostic model asks only that the learner come within epsilon of the best one in the class, and the natural learner minimizes its error on the sample. <bookmark mark='a'/> For a fixed hypothesis, the sample error averages m independent coin flips, and Hoeffding's inequality from Part 20 says it strays more than epsilon from the truth with probability at most two e to the minus two m epsilon squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> A union bound covers the whole class, <bookmark mark='c'/> and solving gives m of order the log of the class size over epsilon squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then the best hypothesis on the sample is within two epsilon of the best of all. <bookmark mark='e'/> Noise costs a square: for the same thousand hypotheses, two thousand one hundred and twenty examples, more than ten times as many.
a60ee06bb02b.zh: 通常没有哪个假设是完美的。不可知模型只要求学习器与类中最好的假设相差在 epsilon 以内，而自然的学习器，就是让自己在样本上的误差最小。<bookmark mark='a'/>对一个固定的假设，样本误差是 m 次独立抛硬币的平均，第20部分的霍夫丁不等式说，它偏离真实值超过 epsilon 的概率，至多是2乘以 e 的负2 m epsilon 平方次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个联合界覆盖整个类，<bookmark mark='c'/>求解得到，m 的量级是类大小的对数除以 epsilon 的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>于是样本上最好的假设，与所有假设中最好的那个相差在2 epsilon 以内。<bookmark mark='e'/>噪声的代价是一个平方：对同样的1000个假设，需要2120个样例，是原来的十倍多。

31904e093399.en: Most interesting classes are infinite, rectangles for instance, and yet rectangles can be learned, by the argument that opens Kearns and Vazirani's textbook. <bookmark mark='a'/> The learner returns the tightest box around the positive examples, which sits inside the target. Draw four strips along the target's sides, each of probability epsilon over four. If an example lands in every strip, the box misses only parts of the strips, so its error is at most epsilon. <bookmark mark='b'/> One strip is missed by all m examples with probability one minus epsilon over four, to the m. <bookmark mark='c'/> A union bound over the four strips, <bookmark mark='d'/> set below delta, <bookmark mark='e'/> gives four over epsilon times the log of four over delta examples, with no class size anywhere.
31904e093399.zh: 大多数有意思的类都是无限的，比如矩形；然而矩形是可以学会的，用的是 Kearns 和 Vazirani 教科书开篇的那个论证。<bookmark mark='a'/>学习器返回围住正例的最紧的方框，它位于目标之内。沿着目标的四条边画四个条带，每个的概率是 epsilon 除以4。如果每个条带里都落有一个样例，方框漏掉的就只是条带的一部分，所以它的误差至多是 epsilon。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个条带被全部 m 个样例错过的概率，是1减 epsilon 除以4的 m 次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>对四个条带取联合界，<bookmark mark='d'/>令它低于 delta，<bookmark mark='e'/>就得到 epsilon 分之4乘以 delta 分之4的对数个样例，哪里都没有类的大小。

6b8890e87d3d.en: How loose is that? Our instrument learned this rectangle two hundred times at each of eight sample sizes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The mean error falls like one over m. <bookmark mark='b'/> The ninety-fifth percentile is the error beaten with probability one minus delta, which is what the theorem bounds. <bookmark mark='c'/> The bound lies above it everywhere; from a hundred examples on, by a factor of two to three. That constant is the price of a guarantee for every distribution, not just the uniform one we sampled.
6b8890e87d3d.zh: 这个界有多松？我们的仪器在8种样本量下，各把这个矩形学了200次。<bookmark mark='a'/>平均误差像 m 分之一那样下降。<bookmark mark='b'/>第95百分位数，是实际误差以1减 delta 的概率低于的那个值，这正是定理所界定的量。<bookmark mark='c'/>界处处都在它上方；从100个样例开始，高出2到3倍。这个常数，是为每一个分布都给出保证所付的代价，而不只是为我们采样所用的均匀分布。

1e9f4a54f079.en: So what replaces the size of the class? <bookmark mark='a'/> For half-planes, as for rectangles, it is infinite. But a learner only meets what the class does on its sample. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ten points can be labelled in a thousand and twenty-four ways. <bookmark mark='c'/> Half-planes produce only ninety-two of them; our instrument checked every labelling with a linear program. <bookmark mark='d'/> That count of behaviours, the growth function, can take the place of the class size, and Chapter two shows that one number, the VC dimension, controls it.
1e9f4a54f079.zh: 那么，用什么来代替类的大小？<bookmark mark='a'/>半平面和矩形一样，是无限的。但学习器遇到的，只是这个类在它的样本上做了什么。<bookmark mark='b'/>10个点可以有1024种标注方式。<bookmark mark='c'/>半平面只能产生其中的92种；我们的仪器用线性规划检查了每一种标注。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个行为的计数，也就是增长函数，可以取代类的大小；而第二章会证明，有一个数，VC 维，控制着它。

8d21ba68c006.en: In 1971 Vladimir Vapnik and Alexey Chervonenkis measured an infinite class not by its size but by how many ways it can label points. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take three points in the plane, not on a line, and colour each green or red: there are eight ways. <bookmark mark='b'/> For every one of them a line puts the greens on one side and the reds on the other; our instrument checked each with a linear program. <bookmark mark='c'/> A class that realizes every labelling of a set is said to shatter it, <bookmark mark='d'/> and the VC dimension is the size of the largest set the class shatters. For half-planes it is at least three.
8d21ba68c006.zh: 1971年，Vladimir Vapnik 和 Alexey Chervonenkis 衡量一个无限的类，不是看它的大小，而是看它能用多少种方式标注点。<bookmark mark='a'/>在平面上取三个不共线的点，把每个涂成绿色或红色：有8种方式。<bookmark mark='b'/>对其中每一种，都有一条直线把绿点放在一侧、红点放在另一侧；我们的仪器用线性规划逐一检查了。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个类如果能实现一个点集的每一种标注，就说它打散了这个点集，<bookmark mark='d'/>而 VC 维，就是这个类能打散的最大点集的大小。对半平面，它至少是3。

c19529c7df82.en: Can half-planes shatter four points? <bookmark mark='a'/> At the corners of a square, fourteen of the sixteen labellings are separable, but not the two that colour opposite corners alike. <bookmark mark='b'/> A half-plane holding both green points holds the segment between them; the other side holds the red segment; the diagonals cross, so no line works. <bookmark mark='c'/> If one point lies inside the triangle of the others, colour it apart, and the same argument applies. <bookmark mark='d'/> Every four points fall into one of these cases: Radon's theorem of 1921, which in d dimensions splits any d plus two points. <bookmark mark='e'/> So half-planes have VC dimension three, half-spaces in d dimensions d plus one, and rectangles four. <bookmark mark='f'/> A lower bound needs one shattered set; an upper bound must defeat every set.
c19529c7df82.zh: 半平面能打散四个点吗？<bookmark mark='a'/>在正方形的四个角上，16种标注中有14种是可分的，但对角同色的那两种不行。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个包含两个绿点的半平面，也包含它们之间的线段；另一侧包含红色的线段；两条对角线相交，所以没有哪条直线行得通。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果有一个点位于另外三个点构成的三角形内部，就把它涂成与其他点不同的颜色，同样的论证依然适用。<bookmark mark='d'/>任何四个点都落入这两种情形之一：这是1921年的 Radon 定理，它在 d 维中能把任意 d 加2个点一分为二。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以半平面的 VC 维是3，d 维中半空间的是 d 加1，矩形的是4。<bookmark mark='f'/>下界只需要一个被打散的点集；上界则必须击败每一个点集。

5254e7ae0365.en: Behind the VC dimension is a function. <bookmark mark='a'/> The growth function counts, for each m, the most labellings the class produces on any m points. <bookmark mark='b'/> A class that shattered everything would follow two to the m, the grey line: a thousand and twenty-four at ten points. <bookmark mark='c'/> Half-planes, counted labelling by labelling, follow it up to three points, the VC dimension, and then fall away, to ninety-two, which is m squared minus m plus two. <bookmark mark='d'/> The yellow curve is the bound we are about to prove from the VC dimension alone. Past the VC dimension, growth is only polynomial.
5254e7ae0365.zh: VC 维背后是一个函数。<bookmark mark='a'/>增长函数对每个 m，计算这个类在任意 m 个点上最多能产生多少种标注。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个能打散一切的类，会沿着2的 m 次方走，就是那条灰线：在10个点时是1024。<bookmark mark='c'/>半平面，一种标注一种标注地数下来，一直跟着它走到3个点，也就是 VC 维，然后就落了下去，落到92，也就是 m 的平方减 m 加2。<bookmark mark='d'/>黄色曲线，是我们马上要只从 VC 维出发证明的界。越过 VC 维之后，增长只是多项式的。

97e5d83d5c17.en: Norbert Sauer and Saharon Shelah proved independently, in 1972, why. <bookmark mark='a'/> If the VC dimension is d, the growth function is at most the number of subsets of size at most d. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are the fourteen labellings of the square's corners, grouped by the first three points. The rows form H one; the boxed rows, which occur with both labels of the last point, form H two. Fourteen is eight plus six. <bookmark mark='c'/> Induct. H one shatters at most d points; H two at most d minus one, or the class would shatter that set plus the last point. <bookmark mark='d'/> Write both bounds as sums, <bookmark mark='e'/> and Pascal's rule adds them into the sum for m: for m at least d, at most e m over d, to the d. A polynomial.
97e5d83d5c17.zh: Norbert Sauer 和 Saharon Shelah 在1972年各自独立地证明了其中的原因。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果 VC 维是 d，增长函数至多是大小不超过 d 的子集的个数。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里是正方形四个角的14种标注，按前三个点分组。这些行构成 H1；加了框的行，也就是在最后一个点的两种标签下都出现的那些，构成 H2。14等于8加6。<bookmark mark='c'/>用归纳法。H1 至多打散 d 个点；H2 至多打散 d 减1个，否则这个类就会打散那个点集再加上最后一个点。<bookmark mark='d'/>把两个界都写成求和，<bookmark mark='e'/>帕斯卡法则把它们加成 m 的那个求和：当 m 至少是 d 时，至多是 e m 除以 d 的 d 次方。一个多项式。

3b0d5bb1b449.en: The growth function can now replace the class size, through a ghost sample. <bookmark mark='a'/> Draw m more points. If a consistent hypothesis has true error above epsilon, with probability at least a half it errs on epsilon m over two ghost points. So the bad event costs at most twice an event about two m points. <bookmark mark='b'/> On those, the class has at most the growth function of two m behaviours, and a random swap between the halves hides all k mistakes of one in the ghost half with probability at most two to the minus k. <bookmark mark='c'/> Set this to delta and solve, <bookmark mark='d'/> and Sauer and Shelah turn the growth function into d times a logarithm. <bookmark mark='e'/> For rectangles d is four: the bound is valid, but an order of magnitude above our measurement. It knows only the VC dimension.
3b0d5bb1b449.zh: 现在，借助一个影子样本，增长函数就可以取代类的大小。<bookmark mark='a'/>再抽 m 个点。如果一个一致的假设，真实误差超过 epsilon，那么它至少以二分之一的概率，在 epsilon m 除以2个影子点上出错。所以坏事件的概率，至多是关于2 m 个点的某个事件的两倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这些点上，这个类至多有“2 m 处的增长函数”那么多种行为；而在两半之间随机交换，把一个假设的全部 k 个错误都藏进影子那一半的概率，至多是2的负 k 次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>令它等于 delta 并求解，<bookmark mark='d'/>Sauer 和 Shelah 就把增长函数变成 d 乘以一个对数。<bookmark mark='e'/>对矩形，d 是4：这个界是成立的，但比我们的测量高出一个数量级。它只知道 VC 维。

cf9a57a7904a.en: Together these give the fundamental theorem of PAC learning, made explicit by Blumer, Ehrenfeucht, Haussler and Warmuth in 1989. <bookmark mark='a'/> For binary classification, four things are equivalent: finite VC dimension, uniform convergence, learnability by any sample-error minimizer, and agnostic learnability. <bookmark mark='b'/> The examples needed are pinned down: about d over epsilon when a perfect hypothesis exists, d over epsilon squared when none does. <bookmark mark='c'/> The converse is the no free lunch argument: if the class shatters two m points, a learner that has seen m of them knows nothing about the rest. <bookmark mark='d'/> Some target forces error at least an eighth with probability at least a seventh. With infinite VC dimension, no amount of data is enough.
cf9a57a7904a.zh: 把这些合起来，就是 PAC 学习的基本定理，由 Blumer、Ehrenfeucht、Haussler 和 Warmuth 在1989年明确写出。<bookmark mark='a'/>对二分类，四件事是等价的：VC 维有限、一致收敛、能被任何样本误差最小化器学会，以及不可知可学习。<bookmark mark='b'/>所需的样例数被确定下来：存在完美假设时，大约是 d 除以 epsilon；不存在时，是 d 除以 epsilon 的平方。<bookmark mark='c'/>反方向是“没有免费的午餐”论证：如果这个类能打散2 m 个点，一个见过其中 m 个的学习器，对其余的点一无所知。<bookmark mark='d'/>某个目标会迫使误差至少是八分之一，而且概率至少是七分之一。VC 维无限时，多少数据都不够。

f906b18a31a5.en: Chapter three. Margins and Rademacher complexity.
f906b18a31a5.zh: 第三章：间隔与 Rademacher 复杂度。

4c23489e6664.en: The oldest learning machine is the one Part 7 put inside a processor. <bookmark mark='a'/> Frank Rosenblatt's perceptron, from 1958, predicts with the sign of a weighted sum. When it is wrong, it adds the example, with its sign, to the weights; otherwise it does nothing. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch it on points that some line separates. Each mistake swings the yellow line, until no point is on the wrong side. <bookmark mark='c'/> What controls the number of mistakes? Not the number of points, and not the dimension, but the margin: the width of the empty band around the best separator, against the radius of the data. <bookmark mark='d'/> Albert Novikoff proved in 1962 that the perceptron makes at most R over gamma, squared, mistakes, however long it runs.
4c23489e6664.zh: 最古老的学习机器，就是第7部分放进处理器里的那一个。<bookmark mark='a'/>罗森布拉特（Frank Rosenblatt）1958年的感知机，用一个加权和的符号来预测。它预测错时，就把这个样例连同它的符号加到权重上；否则什么也不做。<bookmark mark='b'/>看它在一些能被某条直线分开的点上运行。每犯一次错，黄线就摆动一次，直到没有点落在错误的一侧。<bookmark mark='c'/>是什么控制着错误的次数？不是点的个数，也不是维数，而是间隔：最佳分隔线周围那条空白带的宽度，相对于数据的半径而言。<bookmark mark='d'/>Albert Novikoff 在1962年证明，感知机无论运行多久，至多犯 R 除以 gamma 的平方次错。

6e8fb565abb4.en: The proof watches two quantities. Assume every example has length at most R, and a unit vector w star separates them with margin gamma. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, progress. A mistake adds y x, whose projection on w star is at least gamma, so after k mistakes the projection is at least k gamma: linear growth. <bookmark mark='b'/> Second, length. The squared length grows by twice y w dot x, which is not positive on a mistake, plus at most R squared. So after k mistakes the length is at most root k times R: square-root growth. <bookmark mark='c'/> A projection never exceeds a length. <bookmark mark='d'/> So k gamma is at most root k R, and k is at most R over gamma, squared. <bookmark mark='e'/> A line cannot stay under a square root for long: with radius one and margin a tenth, a hundred mistakes at most.
6e8fb565abb4.zh: 证明盯住两个量。假设每个样例的长度至多是 R，并且有一个单位向量 w 星以间隔 gamma 把它们分开。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一，进展。一次错误加上 y x，它在 w 星上的投影至少是 gamma，所以 k 次错误之后，投影至少是 k gamma：线性增长。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二，长度。长度的平方增加2倍的 y 乘以 w 点乘 x，这在出错时不是正的，再加上至多 R 的平方。所以 k 次错误之后，长度至多是根号 k 乘以 R：平方根增长。<bookmark mark='c'/>投影永远不会超过长度。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 k gamma 至多是根号 k 乘 R，k 至多是 R 除以 gamma 的平方。<bookmark mark='e'/>线性增长不可能长久地待在平方根之下：半径为1、间隔为十分之一时，至多100次错误。

101ddc71de4e.en: Our instrument tested the claim. <bookmark mark='a'/> It placed two thousand points on the unit sphere, all at least a tenth from a random hyperplane, in two, ten, a hundred and a thousand dimensions, and ran the perceptron to a clean pass. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mistakes were four, twenty-three, thirty-eight and thirty-four: all under Novikoff's hundred, and flat from a hundred dimensions to a thousand. <bookmark mark='c'/> A VC bound for half-spaces grows with the dimension; the margin bound sees only the geometry. <bookmark mark='d'/> Part 7's branch predictor runs this update in hardware, but branch histories are rarely separable, so there the guarantee does not hold, and only the mistake rate can be measured.
101ddc71de4e.zh: 我们的仪器检验了这个说法。<bookmark mark='a'/>它在单位球面上放了2000个点，全都与一个随机超平面至少相距十分之一，维数分别是2、10、100和1000，并运行感知机，直到完整地过一遍都不出错。<bookmark mark='b'/>错误次数是4、23、38和34：都在 Novikoff 的100之下，而且从100维到1000维基本持平。<bookmark mark='c'/>半空间的 VC 界随维数增长；间隔界只看几何。<bookmark mark='d'/>第7部分的分支预测器在硬件中运行这个更新，但分支历史很少是可分的，所以那里这个保证并不成立，只能测量错误率。

2f13ba9bdbab.en: Margins need a complexity measure that is not a count. Rademacher complexity asks how well the class can fit pure noise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Flip a fair coin for each sample point to get random labels, find the hypothesis that agrees with them best, and average that agreement over the coins. <bookmark mark='b'/> For thresholds on a line, the best threshold catches only part of each draw's noise. <bookmark mark='c'/> A class that shatters the sample matches every draw perfectly; it can explain anything, so its fit to real data proves nothing. <bookmark mark='d'/> The theorem, in the form of Peter Bartlett and Shahar Mendelson in 2002: with probability one minus delta, every hypothesis's true error is at most its sample error, plus twice the Rademacher complexity, plus a term of order one over root m. <bookmark mark='e'/> Massart's lemma bounds the complexity by the growth function, so the VC bounds follow; with margins it can be far smaller.
2f13ba9bdbab.zh: 间隔需要一种不是计数的复杂度度量。Rademacher 复杂度问的是：这个类能把纯噪声拟合得多好。<bookmark mark='a'/>为每个样本点抛一枚均匀的硬币，得到随机标签，找出与它们最吻合的假设，再对所有硬币结果把这个吻合程度取平均。<bookmark mark='b'/>对直线上的阈值，最好的阈值也只能抓住每次抽取中噪声的一部分。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个能打散样本的类，能完美匹配每一次抽取；它什么都能解释，所以它对真实数据的拟合什么也证明不了。<bookmark mark='d'/>定理，按 Peter Bartlett 和 Shahar Mendelson 2002年的形式：以1减 delta 的概率，每个假设的真实误差至多是它的样本误差，加上2倍的 Rademacher 复杂度，再加上一个根号 m 分之一量级的项。<bookmark mark='e'/>Massart 引理用增长函数来界定这个复杂度，所以 VC 界随之而来；而有了间隔，它可以小得多。

22139d5f3f9d.en: For linear classifiers with bounded weights, the Rademacher complexity takes five lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> The supremum over weights of length at most lambda, of w dotted with the sum of signed points, <bookmark mark='b'/> is lambda times the length of that sum, by Cauchy and Schwarz. <bookmark mark='c'/> Jensen's inequality moves the expectation inside a square root. <bookmark mark='d'/> Expanding the square, the cross terms vanish, because independent signs are uncorrelated, <bookmark mark='e'/> and what remains is lambda R over root m. The dimension never appears. <bookmark mark='f'/> Vladimir Koltchinskii and Dmitry Panchenko made this a margin bound in 2002: true error is at most the fraction of sample points with margin below rho, plus a term in R over rho, over root m. <bookmark mark='g'/> R over rho, squared, plays the part of a dimension: exactly Novikoff's quantity. <bookmark mark='h'/> Support vector machines, from Corinna Cortes and Vapnik in 1995, maximize that margin directly. Boosting, as we will see next, does too.
22139d5f3f9d.zh: 对权重有界的线性分类器，Rademacher 复杂度五行就能算出。<bookmark mark='a'/>在长度至多为 lambda 的所有权重上，w 与带符号的点之和的点积的上确界，<bookmark mark='b'/>由柯西–施瓦茨不等式，等于 lambda 乘以这个和的长度。<bookmark mark='c'/>Jensen 不等式把期望移进一个平方根里。<bookmark mark='d'/>把平方展开，交叉项消失，因为独立的符号互不相关，<bookmark mark='e'/>剩下的就是 lambda R 除以根号 m。维数从未出现。<bookmark mark='f'/>Vladimir Koltchinskii 和 Dmitry Panchenko 在2002年把它变成了一个间隔界：真实误差至多是间隔小于 rho 的样本点所占的比例，加上一个 R 除以 rho、再除以根号 m 的项。<bookmark mark='g'/>R 除以 rho 的平方扮演了维数的角色：恰好就是 Novikoff 的那个量。<bookmark mark='h'/>支持向量机，来自1995年的 Corinna Cortes 和 Vapnik，直接最大化这个间隔。提升法，我们接下来会看到，也是如此。

eebc1f852196.en: A strong learner reaches any error with any confidence. A weak learner promises only an error a little below a half, on every distribution. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here no single rule will do: four hundred points, green inside a circle. Our weak learner draws decision stumps, one threshold on one coordinate. <bookmark mark='b'/> With equal weights, the best stump says outside everywhere, wrong on the green twenty-eight and a half per cent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Change the weights and the best stump changes: now it cuts at about point six, with weighted error a third. <bookmark mark='d'/> Michael Kearns and Leslie Valiant asked whether weak learning is really weaker. In 1990 Robert Schapire proved it is not.
eebc1f852196.zh: 强学习器能以任意的置信度达到任意小的误差。弱学习器只承诺，在每个分布上，误差比二分之一低一点点。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里没有哪一条单独的规则能行：400个点，圆内是绿色。我们的弱学习器画的是决策树桩，在一个坐标上取一个阈值。<bookmark mark='b'/>权重相等时，最好的树桩说“处处都在外面”，在占百分之28.5的绿点上出错。<bookmark mark='c'/>改变权重，最好的树桩就变了：现在它切在大约0.6处，加权误差是三分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>Michael Kearns 和 Leslie Valiant 问过：弱学习真的更弱吗？1990年，Robert Schapire 证明了并非如此。

5c742d0f4a34.en: Freund and Schapire's AdaBoost, from 1995, made boosting practical. <bookmark mark='a'/> Keep a weight on every example, equal at first. Each round, ask the weak learner for a rule with small weighted error, <bookmark mark='b'/> and give it a vote that grows as its error shrinks. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then re-weight: examples it got wrong are multiplied up, the rest down, and the weights are normalized. <bookmark mark='d'/> Watch after one, two, five and twenty rounds: easy points far from the circle shrink, and weight piles up on the boundary, where the heaviest point carries about four and a half times its first share. <bookmark mark='e'/> The final classifier is a weighted majority vote.
5c742d0f4a34.zh: Freund 和 Schapire 1995年的 AdaBoost，让提升法变得实用。<bookmark mark='a'/>给每个样例保持一个权重，一开始都相等。每一轮，向弱学习器要一条加权误差小的规则，<bookmark mark='b'/>并给它一票，误差越小，这一票越重。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后重新加权：它判错的样例，权重乘大，其余的乘小，再把权重归一化。<bookmark mark='d'/>看1轮、2轮、5轮和20轮之后：远离圆的容易的点缩小了，权重堆积到边界上，最重的那个点承担了它最初份额的大约4.5倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>最终的分类器是一次加权多数投票。

319cdd66488b.en: Freund and Schapire proved that the training error falls exponentially. <bookmark mark='a'/> Unroll the update: each final weight is e to the minus y F, F being the weighted vote, over m and the product of the normalizers. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a training mistake y F is not positive, so e to the minus y F is at least one, and the training error is at most the average of e to the minus y F. <bookmark mark='c'/> The final weights sum to one, so that average is the product of the normalizers. <bookmark mark='d'/> With AdaBoost's vote, each normalizer is two root epsilon times one minus epsilon. <bookmark mark='e'/> With error a half minus the edge gamma, that is root of one minus four gamma squared, at most e to the minus two gamma squared. <bookmark mark='f'/> So the training error is at most e to the minus twice the sum of squared edges. <bookmark mark='g'/> On our circle it first hit zero at round fifty-seven, and stayed there from round a hundred and eight.
319cdd66488b.zh: Freund 和 Schapire 证明，训练误差指数式地下降。<bookmark mark='a'/>把更新展开：每个最终权重，是 e 的负 y F 次方，F 是加权投票，再除以 m 和各归一化因子的乘积。<bookmark mark='b'/>在一个训练错误上，y F 不是正的，所以 e 的负 y F 次方至少是1，于是训练误差至多是 e 的负 y F 次方的平均。<bookmark mark='c'/>最终权重之和是1，所以这个平均就是各归一化因子的乘积。<bookmark mark='d'/>用 AdaBoost 的投票权，每个归一化因子是2乘以根号下 epsilon 乘以1减 epsilon。<bookmark mark='e'/>误差为二分之一减去优势 gamma 时，它等于根号下1减4 gamma 平方，至多是 e 的负2 gamma 平方次方。<bookmark mark='f'/>所以训练误差至多是 e 的负的2倍优势平方和次方。<bookmark mark='g'/>在我们的圆上，它在第57轮第一次达到零，从第108轮起一直保持为零。

60936e22b386.en: Freund and Schapire also showed that boosting is a game. <bookmark mark='a'/> Make a matrix with a row per example and a column per weak rule, green where the rule is right. The booster picks a distribution over rows; the weak learner answers with the best column. <bookmark mark='b'/> Weak learnability says some column always has an edge of two gamma. <bookmark mark='c'/> Von Neumann's minimax theorem then gives a weighted vote of columns that is right by a margin of two gamma on every row. <bookmark mark='d'/> AdaBoost's re-weighting is multiplicative weights, from Part 23, played on the rows: watch weight move onto the rows the last chosen rule got wrong. Its vote approaches the minimax one.
60936e22b386.zh: Freund 和 Schapire 还证明了，提升法是一场博弈。<bookmark mark='a'/>做一个矩阵，每个样例一行，每条弱规则一列，规则判对的地方是绿色。提升器在行上挑一个分布；弱学习器用最好的一列来回应。<bookmark mark='b'/>弱可学习性说，总有某一列拥有2 gamma 的优势。<bookmark mark='c'/>于是冯·诺依曼的极小极大定理给出各列的一个加权投票，它在每一行上都以2 gamma 的间隔判对。<bookmark mark='d'/>AdaBoost 的重新加权，就是第23部分的乘性权重，在行上运行：看权重移向上一条被选中的规则判错的那些行。它的投票趋近于极小极大的那一个。

285a624b7522.en: Then came a surprise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Training error is zero for good from round a hundred and eight, and classical intuition says more rounds only add complexity, so test error should rise. <bookmark mark='b'/> It does not: it hovers near three per cent for two hundred more rounds. <bookmark mark='c'/> The explanation, from Schapire, Freund, Peter Bartlett and Wee Sun Lee in 1998, is the margin: how decisively the normalized vote gets an example right. Here are the training margins after five, twenty, a hundred and three hundred rounds: long after every point is correct, boosting keeps pushing the smallest up. <bookmark mark='d'/> Their theorem bounds test error by the fraction of training margins below theta, plus a term in the weak rules' VC dimension and theta, not the number of rounds.
285a624b7522.zh: 接着出现了一个意外。<bookmark mark='a'/>从第108轮起，训练误差永久为零，而经典直觉说，更多的轮次只会增加复杂度，所以测试误差应该上升。<bookmark mark='b'/>它没有：在之后的200轮里，它一直徘徊在百分之3附近。<bookmark mark='c'/>解释来自1998年的 Schapire、Freund、Peter Bartlett 和 Wee Sun Lee，那就是间隔：归一化的投票把一个样例判对得有多果断。这里是5轮、20轮、100轮和300轮之后的训练间隔：在每个点都已判对很久之后，提升法还在不断把最小的间隔往上推。<bookmark mark='d'/>他们的定理用小于 theta 的训练间隔所占的比例，加上一个与弱规则的 VC 维和 theta 有关的项，来界定测试误差，而与轮数无关。

e0ac827a8a96.en: The same mechanism is boosting's weakness. <bookmark mark='a'/> Flip five per cent of the labels. Every sensible rule gets a flipped point wrong, so its weight is multiplied up round after round. <bookmark mark='b'/> By round twenty the twenty-three flipped points, under six per cent of the data, hold eighteen per cent of the weight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Test error, on equally noisy test labels, is lowest at round twenty-seven and then creeps up, as boosting memorizes the mistakes. <bookmark mark='d'/> The remedies are to stop early or shrink each vote; Jerome Friedman's gradient boosting of 2001 extended the idea to any loss. AdaBoost won Freund and Schapire the Gödel Prize in 2003.
e0ac827a8a96.zh: 同一个机制也是提升法的弱点。<bookmark mark='a'/>把百分之5的标签翻转。每一条合理的规则都会把某个翻转过的点判错，所以它的权重一轮又一轮地被乘大。<bookmark mark='b'/>到第20轮，那23个被翻转的点，占数据不到百分之6，却握有百分之18的权重。<bookmark mark='c'/>在同样带噪声的测试标签上，测试误差在第27轮最低，然后慢慢爬升，因为提升法记住了这些错误。<bookmark mark='d'/>补救的办法是提前停止，或者缩小每一票；Jerome Friedman 2001年的梯度提升，把这个想法推广到任意损失。AdaBoost 让 Freund 和 Schapire 获得了2003年的哥德尔奖。

aafe50eea14e.en: Now drop the distribution. An adversary picks each example, we predict its label, then see the truth, and we count mistakes. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose one of N hypotheses is perfect. The halving algorithm keeps those still consistent and predicts with their majority. A mistake means the majority was wrong, so at least half are thrown away, <bookmark mark='b'/> and the true one never is. <bookmark mark='c'/> So there are at most log two of N mistakes: for a thousand and twenty-four thresholds, ten. <bookmark mark='d'/> On random examples it made two in two hundred rounds. <bookmark mark='e'/> An adversary who asks about the middle of the survivors forces all ten. <bookmark mark='f'/> Nick Littlestone showed in 1988 that the best mistake bound of a class is one number, its Littlestone dimension. For thresholds on the whole line it is infinite, though their VC dimension is one.
aafe50eea14e.zh: 现在把分布去掉。一个对手挑选每个样例，我们预测它的标签，然后看到真相，并统计错误的次数。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设 N 个假设中有一个是完美的。减半算法保留那些仍然一致的假设，用它们的多数来预测。一次错误意味着多数错了，所以至少有一半被扔掉，<bookmark mark='b'/>而真正的那个永远不会被扔掉。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以错误至多有以2为底 N 的对数那么多次：对1024个阈值，是10次。<bookmark mark='d'/>在随机样例上，它在200轮里犯了2次错。<bookmark mark='e'/>一个总是问幸存者中间位置的对手，能逼出全部10次。<bookmark mark='f'/>Nick Littlestone 在1988年证明，一个类最好的错误界是一个数，也就是它的 Littlestone 维。对整条直线上的阈值，它是无限的，尽管它们的 VC 维是1。

3d150314c2a4.en: Usually no expert is perfect. <bookmark mark='a'/> Littlestone and Manfred Warmuth's weighted majority, published in 1994, starts every expert at weight one, predicts with the weighted vote, and halves every expert that is wrong. <bookmark mark='b'/> If the algorithm errs, at least half the weight voted wrong and is halved, so the total falls to three quarters at most. <bookmark mark='c'/> The best expert, with m mistakes, still holds a half to the m. <bookmark mark='d'/> Take logarithms: at most about two point four times the best expert's mistakes, plus log two of N. No deterministic rule can do much better, since an adversary can make it wrong every round. So we randomize.
3d150314c2a4.zh: 通常没有哪位专家是完美的。<bookmark mark='a'/>Littlestone 和 Manfred Warmuth 的加权多数算法，发表于1994年：一开始每位专家的权重都是1，用加权投票来预测，并把每位说错的专家的权重减半。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果算法出错，至少一半的权重投错了票而被减半，所以总权重至多降到原来的四分之三。<bookmark mark='c'/>最好的专家犯了 m 次错，仍然握有二分之一的 m 次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>取对数：错误至多大约是最好专家错误次数的2.4倍，再加上以2为底 N 的对数。没有哪个确定性的规则能做得好很多，因为对手可以让它每一轮都错。所以我们引入随机。

8b7b255ffeee.en: Freund and Schapire's Hedge, from 1997, plays expert i with probability proportional to its weight, and multiplies each weight by e to the minus eta times that expert's loss. Regret is its expected loss minus the best expert's. Watch the log of the total weight. <bookmark mark='a'/> From below: the total is at least the best expert's weight. <bookmark mark='b'/> From above: each round, by Hoeffding's lemma, the log falls by eta times our expected loss, give or take eta squared over eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Add up the rounds, <bookmark mark='d'/> put the two together, <bookmark mark='e'/> and choose eta as the root of eight log N over T: the regret is at most the root of T log N over two. <bookmark mark='f'/> Per round it goes to zero. It is Part 23's multiplicative weights again.
8b7b255ffeee.zh: Freund 和 Schapire 1997年的 Hedge，以正比于权重的概率采用专家 i，并把每个权重乘以 e 的负 eta 乘以该专家损失次方。遗憾就是它的期望损失减去最好专家的损失。盯住总权重的对数。<bookmark mark='a'/>从下方看：总权重至少是最好专家的权重。<bookmark mark='b'/>从上方看：每一轮，由霍夫丁引理，这个对数下降 eta 乘以我们的期望损失，上下相差 eta 平方除以8。<bookmark mark='c'/>把各轮加起来，<bookmark mark='d'/>把两者放在一起，<bookmark mark='e'/>选 eta 为8 log N 除以 T 的平方根：遗憾至多是 T log N 除以2的平方根。<bookmark mark='f'/>平均到每一轮，它趋于零。这又是第23部分的乘性权重。

986fd01048d5.en: Hedge against twenty experts with random losses for two thousand rounds, one slightly better than the rest. <bookmark mark='a'/> The dashed line is the guarantee for this eta, reaching fifty-four point seven. <bookmark mark='b'/> The measured regret climbs while Hedge finds the best expert, then flattens at thirty point seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> On losses this random, following the leader does even better: nine. <bookmark mark='d'/> But an adversary can ruin it: two experts whose losses alternate, so the leader is always the one about to lose. Follow the leader loses almost every round, each expert half of them, and its regret grows linearly.
986fd01048d5.zh: 让 Hedge 对付20位损失随机的专家，进行2000轮，其中一位比其余的略好一些。<bookmark mark='a'/>虚线是这个 eta 下的保证，最终达到54.7。<bookmark mark='b'/>测得的遗憾在 Hedge 寻找最好专家时攀升，然后在30.7处变平。<bookmark mark='c'/>在这么随机的损失上，跟随领先者做得还要好：9。<bookmark mark='d'/>但对手可以毁掉它：两位专家的损失交替出现，于是领先者总是即将输掉的那一位。跟随领先者几乎每一轮都输，而每位专家只各输一半的轮次，它的遗憾线性增长。

88a94279275b.en: Could a cleverer algorithm beat root T? No. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take two experts and flip a fair coin each round to decide which one loses. <bookmark mark='b'/> Whatever we play, we lose a half per round on average: T over two. <bookmark mark='c'/> But the luckier expert loses T over two minus the distance expert one's count has wandered. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is a random walk; here are ten. Its average distance is about the root of T over two pi, so every algorithm suffers regret of about point four root T. <bookmark mark='e'/> With N experts the same idea gives Hedge's own root of T log N over two: its constant cannot be improved.
88a94279275b.zh: 更聪明的算法能打败根号 T 吗？不能。<bookmark mark='a'/>取两位专家，每一轮抛一枚均匀的硬币来决定哪一位输。<bookmark mark='b'/>无论我们怎么下，平均每轮都输二分之一：一共 T 除以2。<bookmark mark='c'/>但运气更好的那位专家，输掉的是 T 除以2，减去专家1的计数游荡出去的距离。<bookmark mark='d'/>这是一个随机游走；这里有10条。它的平均距离大约是 T 除以2 pi 的平方根，所以每个算法都要承受大约0.4倍根号 T 的遗憾。<bookmark mark='e'/>有 N 位专家时，同样的想法给出 Hedge 自己的那个 T log N 除以2的平方根：它的常数无法再改进。

cee8888069d2.en: The experts are one case of a larger game. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each round we choose a point, then the adversary reveals a convex loss. Martin Zinkevich showed in 2003 that Part 23's gradient descent works here: step against this round's gradient, and project back into the allowed set. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here the losses are parabolas whose centres jump about, and our point chases them. <bookmark mark='c'/> With D the set's diameter and G a bound on the gradients, the regret is at most D squared over two eta plus eta G squared T over two; <bookmark mark='d'/> with the best eta, D G root T. <bookmark mark='e'/> And online turns into batch: feed a training set in one example at a time and average the points played. By convexity the average's expected risk exceeds the best by at most the regret over T.
cee8888069d2.zh: 专家问题是一场更大博弈的一个特例。<bookmark mark='a'/>每一轮我们选一个点，然后对手揭示一个凸的损失。Martin Zinkevich 在2003年证明，第23部分的梯度下降在这里也行得通：逆着这一轮的梯度走一步，再投影回允许的集合。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里的损失是一些抛物线，它们的中心四处跳动，而我们的点追着它们跑。<bookmark mark='c'/>设 D 是集合的直径，G 是梯度的一个上界，遗憾至多是 D 平方除以2 eta，加上 eta G 平方 T 除以2；<bookmark mark='d'/>取最好的 eta，就是 D G 根号 T。<bookmark mark='e'/>而且在线可以变成批量：把训练集一次一个样例地喂进去，再对下过的各个点取平均。由凸性，这个平均点的期望风险，至多比最好的高出遗憾除以 T。

fefb10ece4d9.en: Herbert Robbins posed this problem in 1952. <bookmark mark='a'/> A row of slot machines, each paying out with its own hidden probability. Each round we pull one arm and see only its reward. To find the best arm we must explore; to earn, we must exploit. <bookmark mark='b'/> The measure is regret: what always pulling the best arm would earn, minus what we earn. <bookmark mark='c'/> Grouped by arm, it is each arm's gap times how often we pull it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our four arms pay a half, point four five, point four and point three. <bookmark mark='e'/> Part 44's A/B test explores evenly for a fixed time, then commits, paying for every pull of a worse arm. A bandit algorithm adapts as it goes.
fefb10ece4d9.zh: Herbert Robbins 在1952年提出了这个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一排老虎机，每台以自己隐藏的概率付钱。每一轮我们拉一根拉杆，只看到它的回报。要找到最好的拉杆，我们必须探索；要赚钱，我们必须利用。<bookmark mark='b'/>度量是遗憾：一直拉最好的拉杆能赚到的，减去我们赚到的。<bookmark mark='c'/>按拉杆分组，它就是每根拉杆的差距乘以我们拉它的次数。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的四根拉杆付钱的概率分别是0.5、0.45、0.4和0.3。<bookmark mark='e'/>第44部分的 A/B 测试在固定的时间里均匀地探索，然后定下来，为每一次拉较差的拉杆付出代价。老虎机算法则边走边调整。

a2b4f840bb9a.en: The first strategy is optimism. <bookmark mark='a'/> For each arm keep the average reward, plus a bonus that shrinks as the arm is pulled: the root of two log t over its pull count. Pull the arm whose index, its plausible best case, is highest. <bookmark mark='b'/> By Hoeffding, the true mean exceeds the average by epsilon with probability at most e to the minus two n epsilon squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> With this bonus, the index falls below the truth with probability at most t to the minus four. <bookmark mark='d'/> Watch an illustrative run. The bad arms' bars shrink as they are tried, until they no longer reach the best arm's; after that they are tried only as often as log t grows.
a2b4f840bb9a.zh: 第一种策略是乐观。<bookmark mark='a'/>对每根拉杆，保持平均回报，再加上一个随着它被拉而缩小的加分：2 log t 除以它被拉次数的平方根。拉指标最高的那根，指标就是它合理范围内的最好情形。<bookmark mark='b'/>由霍夫丁不等式，真实均值比平均值高出 epsilon 的概率至多是 e 的负2 n epsilon 平方次方。<bookmark mark='c'/>有了这个加分，指标低于真实值的概率至多是 t 的负4次方。<bookmark mark='d'/>看一次示意性的运行。差的拉杆的柱子随着被尝试而缩短，直到够不着最好拉杆的柱子；在那之后，它们被尝试的频率，只跟 log t 的增长一样快。

825ab87316d1.en: Peter Auer, Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi and Paul Fischer proved in 2002 that this index, UCB1, has regret growing only like log T. <bookmark mark='a'/> Picture a bad arm, a gap delta below the best. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its average is at most w above its mean, and its index adds another w. <bookmark mark='c'/> If we pull it, its index beat the best arm's, which is above mu star. So mu i plus two w reaches mu star, barring a rare failure. <bookmark mark='d'/> Solve: at most eight log T over delta squared pulls. <bookmark mark='e'/> Multiply by the gaps and add a constant for the failures. <bookmark mark='f'/> For our arms over five thousand rounds that is about two thousand four hundred, against a measured hundred and fifty-nine: true, but loose.
825ab87316d1.zh: Peter Auer、Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi 和 Paul Fischer 在2002年证明，这个指标，UCB1，遗憾只像 log T 那样增长。<bookmark mark='a'/>设想一根差的拉杆，比最好的低一个差距 delta。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的平均值至多比它的均值高 w，而它的指标又加上一个 w。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果我们拉了它，它的指标就胜过了最好拉杆的指标，而后者高于 mu 星。所以 mu i 加2 w 达到了 mu 星，除非发生罕见的失败。<bookmark mark='d'/>求解：至多拉8 log T 除以 delta 平方次。<bookmark mark='e'/>乘以各个差距，再为失败加上一个常数。<bookmark mark='f'/>对我们的拉杆，5000轮下来，这大约是2400，而实测是159：成立，但很松。

1db984da9107.en: The second strategy is older. William Thompson proposed it in 1933, with medical treatments in mind. <bookmark mark='a'/> Keep a posterior for each arm's mean: with a uniform prior, a beta distribution set by its wins and losses. Well-tried arms are narrow, rarely tried ones wide. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each round, draw one guess from every posterior and pull the arm whose guess is highest. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then each arm is pulled with exactly the probability that it is the best, given the data, so uncertain arms still get their chances. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 2012 it was proved to meet the optimal rate for such arms.
1db984da9107.zh: 第二种策略更古老。William Thompson 在1933年提出了它，心里想的是医学治疗。<bookmark mark='a'/>为每根拉杆的均值保持一个后验：在均匀先验下，就是一个由它的成功和失败次数确定的贝塔分布。试得多的拉杆，分布窄；很少试的，分布宽。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一轮，从每个后验中抽一个猜测，拉猜测最高的那根。<bookmark mark='c'/>于是每根拉杆被拉的概率，恰好等于在已有数据下它是最好拉杆的概率，所以不确定的拉杆仍然有机会。<bookmark mark='d'/>2012年，人们证明了它对这类拉杆达到最优的速率。

9bd3f7de0b4c.en: Here are the three strategies on our arms, averaged over a hundred runs of five thousand rounds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Epsilon-greedy explores at random one round in twenty, and pays for that forever: its regret ends up linear. <bookmark mark='b'/> UCB1 and Thompson sampling bend over. <bookmark mark='c'/> How far can anyone bend? Tze Leung Lai and Robbins proved in 1985 that any policy good on every problem must pull each bad arm about log T over the divergence between its coin and the best coin. <bookmark mark='d'/> For our arms that is seventeen point four log T. UCB1, at a hundred and fifty-nine, sits above it; Thompson, at about fifty, below it at this T, which the theorem allows: it is about the rate as T grows.
9bd3f7de0b4c.zh: 这里是三种策略在我们的拉杆上的表现，对100次各5000轮的运行取平均。<bookmark mark='a'/>ε-贪心每20轮随机探索一轮，并为此永远付出代价：它的遗憾最终是线性的。<bookmark mark='b'/>UCB1 和汤普森采样弯了下来。<bookmark mark='c'/>任何人最多能弯到什么程度？Tze Leung Lai 和 Robbins 在1985年证明，任何在每个问题上都表现良好的策略，都必须把每根差的拉杆，拉大约 log T 除以它的硬币与最好硬币之间的散度那么多次。<bookmark mark='d'/>对我们的拉杆，这是17.4 log T。UCB1 在159，位于它之上；汤普森采样大约在50，在这个 T 下位于它之下，而定理允许这样：它讲的是 T 增长时的速率。

6abdd371cbf1.en: Why can nobody beat log T? <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a bad arm paying point four five. In another world it pays point five and is the best. After twenty pulls the worlds look alike; <bookmark mark='b'/> after two hundred they part; after two thousand they are clear. <bookmark mark='c'/> The chance of confusing them falls like e to the minus n times their divergence. <bookmark mark='d'/> Confusion in the second world costs a share of every round, so that chance must be about one over T, and n at least log T over the divergence. <bookmark mark='e'/> And if an adversary sets the gap at root K over T, T rounds cannot find the best arm: regret about root K T. <bookmark mark='f'/> Bandits now run recommendation and ad allocation, at the price of a cleaner experiment.
6abdd371cbf1.zh: 为什么没人能打败 log T？<bookmark mark='a'/>取一根付钱概率为0.45的差拉杆。在另一个世界里，它付0.5，是最好的。拉20次之后，两个世界看起来差不多；<bookmark mark='b'/>拉200次之后，它们分开了；拉2000次之后，就清清楚楚了。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它们混淆的概率，像 e 的负 n 乘以它们的散度次方那样下降。<bookmark mark='d'/>在第二个世界里混淆，每一轮都要损失一份，所以这个概率必须大约是 T 分之一，于是 n 至少是 log T 除以散度。<bookmark mark='e'/>而如果对手把差距设成根号下 K 除以 T，T 轮就找不到最好的拉杆：遗憾大约是根号 K T。<bookmark mark='f'/>老虎机算法如今运行着推荐和广告分配，代价是失去一个更干净的实验。

1be2ca740d5f.en: Chapter seven. What cannot be learned.

2d37709174fd.en: Data is rarely what limits learning. <bookmark mark='a'/> There are at most two to the order s log s circuits of size s, so chapter one's bound says polynomially many examples suffice. The trouble is time: finding a hypothesis that fits. <bookmark mark='b'/> Take formulas that are an or of three ands, like this one. Leonard Pitt and Valiant proved in 1988 that finding such a formula consistent with the data is NP-hard. <bookmark mark='c'/> But distribute the or over the ands: the same function is an and of clauses, each taking one literal from each term. <bookmark mark='d'/> Clauses of three literals are few, and Valiant's elimination learns them in polynomial time. The class is easy; its own representation was hard. <bookmark mark='e'/> So real limits must hold whatever the learner outputs.
2d37709174fd.zh: 限制学习的很少是数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>规模为 s 的电路至多有2的 s log s 量级次方个，所以第一章的界说，多项式个样例就够了。麻烦在于时间：找到一个能拟合的假设。<bookmark mark='b'/>取那些由三个“与”组成的“或”的公式，就像这一个。Leonard Pitt 和 Valiant 在1988年证明，找到一个与数据一致的这种公式是 NP 难的。<bookmark mark='c'/>但把“或”分配到各个“与”上：同一个函数就是若干子句的“与”，每个子句从每一项中取一个文字。<bookmark mark='d'/>三个文字的子句数量不多，而 Valiant 的消去算法能在多项式时间内学会它们。这个类是容易的；难的是它自己的表示。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以真正的限制，必须无论学习器输出什么都成立。

d17f045175ff.en: Michael Kearns and Leslie Valiant found such limits in cryptography; the journal version appeared in 1994. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a public-key cryptosystem. Anyone with the public key can encrypt random bits, so anyone can make labelled examples: a ciphertext, and the bit inside it. <bookmark mark='b'/> The target concept is the decryption function. <bookmark mark='c'/> If some class of functions can compute decryption, a learner for that class, fed these examples, returns a hypothesis that decrypts a fresh challenge better than chance. That breaks the cryptosystem. <bookmark mark='d'/> So, if RSA or factoring is hard, no efficient algorithm learns small Boolean formulas or finite automata, whatever it outputs. <bookmark mark='e'/> And if pseudorandom functions exist, from Part 29, small circuits cannot be learned even by asking questions.
d17f045175ff.zh: Michael Kearns 和 Leslie Valiant 在密码学中找到了这样的限制；期刊版本发表于1994年。<bookmark mark='a'/>取一个公钥密码系统。任何拿到公钥的人都能加密随机比特，所以任何人都能制作带标签的样例：一个密文，以及藏在里面的那个比特。<bookmark mark='b'/>目标概念就是解密函数。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果某一类函数能计算解密，那么这个类的一个学习器，喂给它这些样例，就会返回一个假设，它解密一个新的挑战密文，效果比瞎猜好。这就攻破了这个密码系统。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以，如果 RSA 或因数分解是困难的，就没有高效的算法能学会小的布尔公式或有限自动机，无论它输出什么。<bookmark mark='e'/>而如果第29部分的伪随机函数存在，小电路即使通过提问也学不会。

b0271d528133.en: Kearns also defined a gentler kind of learner. <bookmark mark='a'/> A statistical-query learner never looks at single examples; it asks for the average of some function of an example and its label, and gets it to within a tolerance tau. Such learners survive noisy labels, and gradient descent on an average loss is one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Now let the label be the parity of an unknown set of k bits. Different parities are orthogonal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Any query splits into a part that ignores the label and a part that correlates with it, and only the second depends on the set. <bookmark mark='d'/> By Bessel's inequality those correlations have squares summing to at most one, so each query is informative about at most one over tau squared sets. <bookmark mark='e'/> The rest look identical, so finding the set takes at least tau squared times n choose k queries.
b0271d528133.zh: Kearns 还定义了一种更温和的学习器。<bookmark mark='a'/>统计查询学习器从不查看单个样例；它请求关于样例及其标签的某个函数的平均值，并得到一个误差在容差 tau 以内的结果。这样的学习器经得起带噪声的标签，而在平均损失上做梯度下降就是其中一种。<bookmark mark='b'/>现在让标签是一个未知的 k 比特集合的奇偶性。不同的奇偶函数彼此正交。<bookmark mark='c'/>任何查询都可以拆成一个不管标签的部分，和一个与标签相关的部分，而只有后者依赖于那个集合。<bookmark mark='d'/>由 Bessel 不等式，这些相关性的平方和至多是1，所以每次查询至多能对 tau 平方分之一个集合提供信息。<bookmark mark='e'/>其余的集合看起来完全一样，所以找到那个集合至少需要 tau 平方乘以 n 选 k 次查询。

6b04c4f2a077.en: Here are sparse parities of three bits among n, from four hundred random examples. <bookmark mark='a'/> No single bit correlates with the label beyond the sampling noise. <bookmark mark='b'/> A search over sets of three bits must try up to n choose three of them, and it did: fifteen hundred and eight of fifteen hundred and forty at n equal to twenty-two. <bookmark mark='c'/> Yet parity is easy for algebra. Each example is a linear equation over the field of two elements, and Gaussian elimination, from Part 52, done over that field, solves it from about two n examples in under a millisecond. Parity is learnable, just not by statistics. <bookmark mark='d'/> Flip a few labels and elimination breaks. Learning parity with noise is believed hard; the best known algorithm, by Avrim Blum, Adam Kalai and Hal Wasserman, takes time two to the n over log n. <bookmark mark='e'/> It is Part 7's parity branch again: no single history bit predicts it.
6b04c4f2a077.zh: 这里是 n 个比特中3个比特的稀疏奇偶，来自400个随机样例。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有哪个单独的比特与标签的相关性超出抽样噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/>对三比特集合的搜索，至多要尝试 n 选3个，而它确实试了：在 n 等于22时，1540个中试了1508个。<bookmark mark='c'/>然而奇偶性对代数来说很容易。每个样例都是二元域上的一个线性方程，而第52部分的高斯消元，在这个域上进行，用大约2 n 个样例，不到1毫秒就能解出它。奇偶性是可学的，只是不能靠统计。<bookmark mark='d'/>翻转几个标签，消元就失效了。带噪声的奇偶学习被认为是困难的；已知最好的算法，出自 Avrim Blum、Adam Kalai 和 Hal Wasserman，需要2的 n 除以 log n 次方的时间。<bookmark mark='e'/>这又是第7部分的奇偶分支：没有哪个单独的历史比特能预测它。

2b0c7feac6d0.en: So the map of what can be learned has three walls. <bookmark mark='a'/> The outer wall is statistical: a class with infinite VC dimension cannot be learned from any amount of data. <bookmark mark='b'/> Inside it, the computational wall. Small formulas, automata and circuits need few examples, but learning them would break cryptography. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inside that, the statistical-query wall. Conjunctions and halfspaces with a margin sit inside it and survive noise; <bookmark mark='d'/> parities sit between, learnable only by algebra that a single wrong label spoils. Avrim Blum and colleagues showed in 1994 that this wall is set by one number, the statistical-query dimension: how many nearly orthogonal functions a class contains.
2b0c7feac6d0.zh: 所以，可学之物的地图有三道墙。<bookmark mark='a'/>外墙是统计的：VC 维无限的类，无论多少数据都学不会。<bookmark mark='b'/>在它里面，是计算之墙。小的公式、自动机和电路只需要很少的样例，但学会它们就会攻破密码学。<bookmark mark='c'/>再往里，是统计查询之墙。合取式和带间隔的半空间位于它里面，经得起噪声；<bookmark mark='d'/>奇偶函数位于两墙之间，只能用代数学会，而一个错误的标签就能把它毁掉。Avrim Blum 和同事在1994年证明，这道墙由一个数决定，也就是统计查询维：一个类包含多少个几乎正交的函数。

e68270af95f0.en: Chapter eight. More parameters than data.
e68270af95f0.zh: 第八章：参数比数据还多。

4de2fda618d9.en: Here is the experiment of the hook again, with both errors. Fifty noisy examples; a linear model on the first p of two hundred Gaussian features, fitted by least squares, choosing the smallest solution when there are many. <bookmark mark='a'/> The training error falls as p grows, and from p equal to fifty on it is zero, up to the rounding of Part 4's floating point: the model interpolates, noise and all. <bookmark mark='b'/> The test error rises to fifty-two at the threshold, <bookmark mark='c'/> then falls, to point seven eight at two hundred parameters, below the one point oh three of the smallest model. Mikhail Belkin, Daniel Hsu, Siyuan Ma and Soumik Mandal named this double descent in 2019. In this simple setting there is no first valley at all: a classical textbook would have stopped at the smallest model, and missed the better one beyond.
4de2fda618d9.zh: 这又是开场的那个实验，这次两种误差都画了出来。50个带噪声的样例；一个线性模型，用的是200个高斯特征中的前 p 个，用最小二乘拟合，解有很多个时选最小的那个。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练误差随 p 增大而下降，从 p 等于50开始就是零，只差第4部分浮点数的舍入：模型插值了数据，连噪声一起。<bookmark mark='b'/>测试误差在阈值处升到52，<bookmark mark='c'/>然后下降，在200个参数时降到0.78，低于最小模型的1.03。Mikhail Belkin、Daniel Hsu、Siyuan Ma 和 Soumik Mandal 在2019年把它命名为双下降。在这个简单的设定里，根本没有第一个谷：一本经典教科书会停在最小的模型上，错过远处那个更好的。

0cfb6506b745.en: Why is this a puzzle? <bookmark mark='a'/> Chapter three measured a class by how well it fits pure noise: random signs, and the best correlation the class can achieve with them. <bookmark mark='b'/> A model with at least as many parameters as examples fits any labelling at all, so that complexity takes its largest value, one. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the bound becomes useless: test error at most the training error, zero, plus one, plus more. <bookmark mark='d'/> Chiyuan Zhang and colleagues showed in 2017 that real networks are like this. Standard image networks fitted CIFAR-10 with random labels to zero training error, and then of course predicted at chance; on the true labels the same networks generalize well. <bookmark mark='e'/> So the answer is not in the class. It is in which interpolating solution the algorithm picks.
0cfb6506b745.zh: 为什么这是个谜题？<bookmark mark='a'/>第三章用一个类拟合纯噪声的能力来衡量它：随机的符号，以及这个类与它们所能达到的最好相关性。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个参数至少和样例一样多的模型，能拟合任何标注，所以这个复杂度取到它的最大值，1。<bookmark mark='c'/>于是界变得毫无用处：测试误差至多是训练误差，零，加1，再加更多。<bookmark mark='d'/>Chiyuan Zhang 和同事在2017年证明，真实的网络就是这样。标准的图像网络在随机标签的 CIFAR-10 上拟合到零训练误差，然后当然只能以瞎猜的水平预测；而在真实标签上，同样的网络泛化得很好。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以答案不在类里。它在于算法挑中了哪一个插值解。

6f1bb1255bbb.en: Past the threshold there are more unknowns than equations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Draw the smallest case: one example, two parameters. Every point on this line fits the example exactly; in general the solutions form a flat of dimension p minus n. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our experiment picks the one of smallest length. Grow a circle from the origin until it touches the line. <bookmark mark='c'/> It touches where the radius is perpendicular to the line, that is, along the example itself. In general the minimum-norm solution is a combination of the rows of X. <bookmark mark='d'/> Substitute that into the equations and solve: X transpose, times the inverse of X X transpose, times y. This is the pseudo-inverse, and the one in our experiment.
6f1bb1255bbb.zh: 越过阈值，未知数就比方程多。<bookmark mark='a'/>画出最小的情形：一个样例，两个参数。这条直线上的每一个点都恰好拟合这个样例；一般地，解构成一个 p 减 n 维的平坦子空间。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的实验挑长度最小的那个。从原点开始让一个圆变大，直到碰到这条直线。<bookmark mark='c'/>它碰到的地方，半径与直线垂直，也就是沿着样例本身的方向。一般地，最小范数解是 X 的各行的一个组合。<bookmark mark='d'/>把它代入方程并求解：X 转置，乘以 X 乘 X 转置的逆，再乘以 y。这就是伪逆，也就是我们实验里用的那一个。

8701fc96704a.en: Nobody trains a network by calling the pseudo-inverse. But they do run gradient descent. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the squared error, each step subtracts X transpose times the residual: a combination of the rows. <bookmark mark='b'/> Start at zero, and you never leave the row space. <bookmark mark='c'/> Watch: the yellow path runs straight along the example's direction and stops on the line at the smallest solution. <bookmark mark='d'/> Started elsewhere, it lands somewhere else on the line. So from zero, the limit fits the data and lies in the row space, and only one solution does both. <bookmark mark='e'/> The algorithm chose the smallest norm by itself: an implicit bias. For the logistic loss on separable data, gradient descent heads for the maximum margin, chapter three's margins again.
8701fc96704a.zh: 没有人通过调用伪逆来训练网络。但他们确实运行梯度下降。<bookmark mark='a'/>在平方误差上，每一步减去 X 转置乘以残差：这是各行的一个组合。<bookmark mark='b'/>从零出发，你就永远不会离开行空间。<bookmark mark='c'/>看：黄色路径笔直地沿着样例的方向前进，停在直线上最小的那个解处。<bookmark mark='d'/>从别处出发，它就落在直线上的别处。所以从零出发，极限既拟合数据，又位于行空间中，而只有一个解同时做到这两点。<bookmark mark='e'/>算法自己选中了最小范数：这是一种隐式偏好。对可分数据上的逻辑损失，梯度下降朝着最大间隔的方向前进，又是第三章的间隔。

167ecfec61d4.en: Why does the error explode at the threshold, and fall after it? <bookmark mark='a'/> The fitted parameters miss the true ones by a bias and by the pseudo-inverse applied to the noise, where the noise includes the features the model cannot see. <bookmark mark='b'/> With fewer parameters than examples, the noise term's average is the noise variance times p over n minus p minus one: the mean of an inverse Wishart matrix. <bookmark mark='c'/> With more, the same argument transposed gives n over p minus n minus one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Both blow up as p approaches n, where X is square and its smallest singular value is near zero: Part 52's ill-conditioning. <bookmark mark='e'/> The formula's curves, drawn for a target of norm one, follow our measurements on both sides of the peak. Past it, the spare directions share the noise, and the smallest solution damps it.
167ecfec61d4.zh: 为什么误差在阈值处爆炸，又在它之后下降？<bookmark mark='a'/>拟合出的参数与真实参数之差，来自一个偏差，以及作用在噪声上的伪逆，而这里的噪声包括模型看不到的那些特征。<bookmark mark='b'/>参数少于样例时，噪声项的平均值是噪声方差乘以 p 除以 n 减 p 减1：这是一个逆 Wishart 矩阵的均值。<bookmark mark='c'/>参数更多时，把同样的论证转置过来，得到 n 除以 p 减 n 减1。<bookmark mark='d'/>当 p 接近 n 时，两者都会爆炸，这时 X 是方阵，它最小的奇异值接近零：这是第52部分的病态。<bookmark mark='e'/>对一个范数为1的目标画出的公式曲线，在峰的两侧都与我们的测量吻合。越过峰之后，多余的方向分担了噪声，而最小的解把它压了下去。

01d500ebab98.en: William of Ockham said not to multiply entities beyond necessity. Learning theory makes it a theorem. <bookmark mark='a'/> Describe each hypothesis in a prefix-free code, like the leaves of this tree. Kraft's inequality says two to the minus the lengths add up to at most one. <bookmark mark='b'/> So share out the failure probability delta in those proportions: a short hypothesis gets a large share. <bookmark mark='c'/> By chapter one's argument, a hypothesis with error above epsilon survives m examples with probability e to the minus epsilon m; set that equal to its share. <bookmark mark='d'/> Solve: its error is at most its length in bits, times log two, plus log of one over delta, all over m. The union bound spends at most delta. Anselm Blumer, Andrzej Ehrenfeucht, David Haussler and Manfred Warmuth called this Occam's razor, in 1987. Short descriptions generalize, not because nature is simple, but because there are few of them.
01d500ebab98.zh: 奥卡姆的威廉（William of Ockham）说，如无必要，勿增实体。学习理论把它变成了一个定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>用一种无前缀码描述每个假设，就像这棵树的叶子。Kraft 不等式说，2的负码长次方加起来至多是1。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以按这些比例分配失败概率 delta：短的假设分到大的一份。<bookmark mark='c'/>按第一章的论证，误差超过 epsilon 的假设在 m 个样例上存活的概率是 e 的负 epsilon m 次方；令它等于这个假设的那一份。<bookmark mark='d'/>求解：它的误差至多是它以比特计的长度乘以 log 2，加上 delta 分之一的对数，全部除以 m。联合界总共至多花掉 delta。Anselm Blumer、Andrzej Ehrenfeucht、David Haussler 和 Manfred Warmuth 在1987年把它称为奥卡姆剃刀。短的描述能够泛化，不是因为大自然是简单的，而是因为短的描述很少。

942cadc8ac1b.en: Nick Littlestone and Manfred Warmuth turned this around in 1986. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two hundred points, labelled by a hidden rectangle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Keep only four: the extreme positive points. From them alone, rebuild the tightest box, and it labels all two hundred correctly. That is a compression scheme of size four. <bookmark mark='c'/> Why does it generalize? Fix which four positions are kept. The box depends only on those, so the other hundred and ninety-six are fresh examples it happened to fit. <bookmark mark='d'/> Take the union bound over at most m to the k choices, <bookmark mark='e'/> and solve: k log m plus log one over delta, over m minus k. <bookmark mark='f'/> Here that is point one two three. The box's true error is point zero one seven; the bound is safe, and of the same order as chapter one's.
942cadc8ac1b.zh: Nick Littlestone 和 Manfred Warmuth 在1986年把它反了过来。<bookmark mark='a'/>200个点，由一个隐藏的矩形标注。<bookmark mark='b'/>只保留4个：最极端的那几个正例点。只用它们，重建最紧的方框，它就把全部200个点都标对了。这是一个大小为4的压缩方案。<bookmark mark='c'/>它为什么能泛化？固定保留哪4个位置。方框只依赖于这几个点，所以另外196个，就是它恰好拟合上的新样例。<bookmark mark='d'/>对至多 m 的 k 次方种选择取联合界，<bookmark mark='e'/>求解：k log m 加上 delta 分之一的对数，除以 m 减 k。<bookmark mark='f'/>这里它是0.123。方框的真实误差是0.017；这个界是安全的，而且与第一章的界同一个量级。

45ace9bdbafe.en: Compression explains chapter three's puzzle too. <bookmark mark='a'/> Keep only the examples the perceptron got wrong, in the order it met them. Run it on those alone: it makes the same mistakes in the same order and finishes with the same weights, which fit everything. <bookmark mark='b'/> So the perceptron is a compression scheme whose size is its number of mistakes, at most one over the margin squared, a hundred here, whatever the dimension. <bookmark mark='c'/> On two thousand points the VC dimension climbs to a thousand, <bookmark mark='d'/> while the scheme never needs more than thirty-eight. <bookmark mark='e'/> The compression bound stays under about a seventh, even in a thousand dimensions, where no VC bound says anything. Margins, not dimensions, decide, because a large margin means a short description.
45ace9bdbafe.zh: 压缩也解释了第三章的谜题。<bookmark mark='a'/>只保留感知机判错的那些样例，按它遇到的顺序。只在这些样例上运行它：它按同样的顺序犯同样的错误，最后得到同样的权重，而这组权重拟合所有的点。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以感知机是一个压缩方案，它的大小就是它的错误次数，至多是间隔平方分之一，这里是100，无论维数是多少。<bookmark mark='c'/>在2000个点上，VC 维爬升到1000，<bookmark mark='d'/>而这个方案从来不需要超过38个点。<bookmark mark='e'/>压缩界一直保持在大约七分之一以下，即使在1000维，那里没有任何 VC 界能说出什么。起决定作用的是间隔，而不是维数，因为大的间隔意味着短的描述。

270a3fa33bcc.en: There is a third way to say the same thing, as a message. <bookmark mark='a'/> The receiver has the two hundred points and needs their labels. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sent one by one, that is two hundred bits. <bookmark mark='c'/> Coded by their frequency, forty-one positives in two hundred, about a hundred and forty-six. <bookmark mark='d'/> But send the four indices of the box's points, about thirty-one bits, and the receiver rebuilds the box and every label follows. Feed those thirty-one bits to Occam's bound and it says point one two one: the compression bound's answer, seen as a message. <bookmark mark='e'/> Jorma Rissanen's minimum description length principle, from 1978, chooses the hypothesis that minimizes the bits to describe it plus the bits to describe its exceptions. <bookmark mark='f'/> It is the bargain of Part 21's compressors: every regularity claimed must pay for itself in bits.
270a3fa33bcc.zh: 还有第三种方式说同一件事：把它当作一条消息。<bookmark mark='a'/>接收者有这200个点，需要它们的标签。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个一个地发，就是200比特。<bookmark mark='c'/>按频率编码，200个中有41个正例，大约146比特。<bookmark mark='d'/>但发送方框那4个点的下标，大约31比特，接收者就能重建方框，每个标签随之而来。把这31比特喂给奥卡姆的界，它给出0.121：这正是压缩界的答案，只是被看作一条消息。<bookmark mark='e'/>Jorma Rissanen 1978年的最小描述长度原则，选择这样的假设：描述它所需的比特，加上描述它的例外所需的比特，总和最小。<bookmark mark='f'/>这就是第21部分那些压缩器的交易：声称的每一条规律，都必须用比特为自己买单。

65465d958d16.en: Put the bounds side by side. <bookmark mark='a'/> The finite class of chapter one, the bits of Occam's razor, the kept points of a compression scheme, and the VC dimension of chapter two. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each says the same thing: error falls like the complexity, times a logarithm, over the number of examples. <bookmark mark='c'/> Compression implies learning. Does learning imply compression, with a scheme as small as the VC dimension? Littlestone and Warmuth asked in 1986, and it is still open. That is the frontier. Each measure, in the end, counts what the learner must remember.
65465d958d16.zh: 把这些界并排放在一起。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一章的有限类，奥卡姆剃刀的比特，压缩方案保留的点，以及第二章的 VC 维。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一个说的都是同一件事：误差像复杂度乘以一个对数、再除以样例数那样下降。<bookmark mark='c'/>压缩蕴含学习。那么学习是否蕴含压缩，而且方案能小到 VC 维那么小？Littlestone 和 Warmuth 在1986年提出了这个问题，它至今悬而未决。那就是前沿。每一种度量，归根到底，数的都是学习器必须记住的东西。

901a1b88c7b7.en: Chapter ten, the frontier. Is learning exactly compression?
901a1b88c7b7.zh: 第十章，前沿。学习恰好就是压缩吗？

9186b8a0a31d.en: A learner that generalizes must, in some sense, have compressed its data. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are 200 points labelled by a hidden rectangle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Keep just four of them: the leftmost, rightmost, lowest and highest positive points. <bookmark mark='c'/> The tightest box through those four labels every one of the 200 points correctly. Nick Littlestone and Manfred Warmuth called this a sample compression scheme, and showed in 1986 that a scheme of size k gives a learning bound much like VC dimension k. <bookmark mark='d'/> Warmuth conjectured that every class of VC dimension d has a scheme of size proportional to d. In 2016 Shay Moran and Amir Yehudayoff proved that a scheme of size exponential in d always exists. Whether linear size is always possible is still open.
9186b8a0a31d.zh: 一个能泛化的学习器，在某种意义上一定压缩了它的数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里有200个点，由一个隐藏的矩形标注。<bookmark mark='b'/>只保留其中4个：最左、最右、最低和最高的正例点。<bookmark mark='c'/>穿过这4个点的最紧的方框，把200个点中的每一个都标注得正确。Nick Littlestone 和 Manfred Warmuth 把这叫作样本压缩方案，并在1986年证明，大小为 k 的方案给出的学习界，很像 VC 维为 k 时的界。<bookmark mark='d'/>Warmuth 猜想，每个 VC 维为 d 的类，都有一个大小与 d 成正比的方案。2016年，Shay Moran 和 Amir Yehudayoff 证明，大小为 d 的指数的方案总是存在。线性大小是否总是可能，至今仍未解决。

45dda84b01b8.en: The newest puzzle comes from language models. <bookmark mark='a'/> Shown a few input-output examples in its prompt, a trained model can predict the answer for a new input, without any change to its weights. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2022 Shivam Garg and colleagues trained transformers on prompts of linear regression problems and found they matched least squares, and constructions show that attention can carry out steps of gradient descent. <bookmark mark='c'/> What theory still lacks is a bound that says when this works and how many examples a prompt needs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Double descent's second dip, benign overfitting, is now well understood for linear models like ours; for deep networks, only partly.
45dda84b01b8.zh: 最新的谜题来自语言模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>在提示里给它看几个输入–输出样例，一个训练好的模型就能预测一个新输入的答案，而它的权重没有任何改变。<bookmark mark='b'/>2022年，Shivam Garg 和同事用由线性回归问题组成的提示训练 Transformer，发现它们与最小二乘的表现相当；还有一些构造表明，注意力可以执行梯度下降的步骤。<bookmark mark='c'/>理论仍然缺少的，是一个界，说明这在什么时候行得通，以及一个提示需要多少样例。<bookmark mark='d'/>双下降的第二次下降，也就是良性过拟合，对像我们这样的线性模型，现在已经理解得很好；对深度网络，只理解了一部分。

bc7ce047265f.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> A bound on the generalization of deep networks that is not vacuous at the sizes people actually use. <bookmark mark='b'/> A theory of what prompts can teach. <bookmark mark='c'/> Whether parity can be learned efficiently when some labels are flipped, which much of modern cryptography assumes is impossible. <bookmark mark='d'/> And matching upper and lower bounds for bandits with structure. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem is Warmuth's: does every class of VC dimension d have a compression scheme of size proportional to d?
bc7ce047265f.zh: 未解决的问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个关于深度网络泛化的界，在人们实际使用的规模上是非空的。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个关于提示能教会什么的理论。<bookmark mark='c'/>当一些标签被翻转时，奇偶性能否被高效地学会，而现代密码学的很大一部分都假设这是不可能的。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有，让带结构的老虎机问题的上界和下界相互匹配。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题是 Warmuth 的：每个 VC 维为 d 的类，是否都有一个大小与 d 成正比的压缩方案？

0d55e50d6644.en: What we built in this part. PAC learning, where a finite class needs examples in proportion to the logarithm of its size. The VC dimension, the Sauer–Shelah lemma, and the fundamental theorem: a class is learnable exactly when its VC dimension is finite. Margins, which bound the perceptron's mistakes and explain boosting, whatever the dimension. Online learning against an adversary, where regret grows like a square root, and bandits that balance exploring against exploiting. Problems such as sparse parity that no statistical learner can find quickly. And double descent and compression. One idea runs through it: learning is possible exactly when the hypotheses are simple enough to be pinned down by the data.
0d55e50d6644.zh: 我们在这一部分搭建了什么。PAC 学习，其中一个有限类需要的样例数，与它大小的对数成正比。VC 维、Sauer–Shelah 引理，以及基本定理：一个类可学习，恰好当它的 VC 维有限。间隔，它界定了感知机的错误次数，并解释了提升法，无论维数是多少。对抗一个对手的在线学习，其中遗憾像平方根那样增长；还有在探索与利用之间取得平衡的老虎机算法。像稀疏奇偶这样的问题，没有哪个统计学习器能快速找到。还有双下降与压缩。贯穿始终的是一个想法：学习是可能的，恰好当假设简单到足以被数据确定下来。

c9d750d86193.en: Where this comes back. Part 58 asks what programs mean, and how to prove two of them the same. Part 59 studies what many machines can compute together. Part 60 builds the hardware that trains and runs learned models. And Part 61 asks how to measure a result honestly, and returns to the bridge between this series and AI, Built.
c9d750d86193.zh: 它们会在哪里再出现。第58部分问程序意味着什么，以及如何证明两个程序是相同的。第59部分研究许多台机器一起能计算什么。第60部分搭建训练和运行学习模型的硬件。而第61部分问如何诚实地衡量一个结果，并回到这个系列与《人工智能，从零搭建》之间的那座桥。

e54ef8a9d726.en: In practice. Hold out data the model never sees, and never tune on the test set. When the model is already flexible, more data usually beats a cleverer model. Control capacity with margins, weight decay and early stopping. Use bandits for online choices; Thompson sampling is a strong default. And when a result looks too good, look for leakage first.
e54ef8a9d726.zh: 在实践中。留出模型从未见过的数据，永远不要在测试集上调参。当模型已经足够灵活时，更多的数据通常胜过更聪明的模型。用间隔、权重衰减和提前停止来控制容量。在线选择用老虎机算法；汤普森采样是一个强有力的默认选择。而当一个结果好得令人难以置信时，先去找数据泄漏。

37e75db0b217.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: implement two bandit algorithms and compare their regret with the Lai–Robbins rate. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: whether every class of VC dimension d can be compressed to a number of points proportional to d.
37e75db0b217.zh: 六道习题，完整的解答在这一部分的笔记里。随时可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是一道动手题：实现两个老虎机算法，并把它们的遗憾与 Lai–Robbins 速率作比较。最后一道标了星号，是一道研究题：是否每个 VC 维为 d 的类，都能被压缩成与 d 成正比个数的点。

8f4586a5594c.en: Next time, Part 58: semantics. What does a program mean? Three answers: the steps a machine takes, the mathematical object a program denotes, and the laws it obeys, with a theorem that writes code's properties for free.
8f4586a5594c.zh: 下一次，第58部分：语义。一个程序意味着什么？三个答案：机器所走的步骤，程序所指称的数学对象，以及它所遵守的定律，还有一个能免费写出代码性质的定理。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
